theme: Reproducible Large-Model Performance and Solver Maturity

level_up_2.scope: active large-model performance and solver maturity

global_accounting.accounting_rule: Level-Up 1 and Level-Up 2 are sequential program blocks; their weights are not added to a second historical percentage view.

work_packages.title: Evidence and Performance Observatory
work_packages.objective: Install a deterministic performance evidence model for setup, operator, preconditioner, solve, communication, post-processing and resource metrics.
pass_criteria: Each run records source/config/input/output digests and the declared environment.
Timing, iterations, matvecs, RSS and phase boundaries use stable field names and units.
Existing evidence is referenced without being rewritten or relabeled as current.
stop_conditions: missing provenance for a performance claim
derived metric presented without its raw measurements

work_packages.title: CPU/MPI/GAMG readiness and configuration freeze
work_packages.objective: Freeze the reproducible CPU, MPI, PETSc, KSP, preconditioner and resource configuration before large runs.
pass_criteria: CPU, RAM, OS, Python, NumPy, SciPy, PETSc, MPI, ranks, threads, KSP and PC are explicit.
The selected backend fails closed when unavailable and never falls back silently.
The frozen configuration and budgets are recorded before WP03-WP05 execution.
The same 3M FEM workload is executed at 2, 4 and 8 ranks with required replays and declared phase/resource metrics.
work_packages.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS; freeze is bounded to the recorded single-host Docker/PETSc environment and leaves unmeasured phase fields explicitly null.
limitations: Preflight, redistribution, communication and I/O are not separately measured by the legacy runner and are not inferred.
Performance evidence is bounded to the recorded structured TET4 3M workload, host, container image, MPI ranks and configuration.
The frozen AIJ/GAMG route is selected from the recorded subscale; HYPRE and graph partitioning remain characterized alternatives, not universal rankings.

work_packages.title: 3M Gold Compute
work_packages.objective: Extend the existing 3M Silver evidence with a materially distinct workload under the frozen route.
pass_criteria: The existing 3M Silver case remains the controlled reference.
A second materially distinct 3M FEM workload completes with two replays.
Residual, equilibrium, energy, finiteness, time, RAM, provenance and configuration pass.
The claim is bounded to structured TET4 linear-static FEM and the recorded machine/MPI configuration.
work_packages.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: the existing Silver case remains controlled and a materially distinct 3M TET4 workload completed two compatible replays under the unchanged WP02 freeze.
limitations: Gold Compute is bounded to structured TET4 homogeneous isotropic linear-static FEM on the pinned single-host Docker/PETSc/MPI configuration.
Preflight, redistribution, communication and I/O phases remain explicitly NOT_MEASURED because the runner does not expose them separately.
The evidence makes no universal, multi-node, GPU, mixed-mesh, nonlinear or restart claim; Workload B is descriptive rather than a speed benchmark against Workload A.

work_packages.title: 5M Bronze
work_packages.objective: Construct and preflight a real 5M-DOF FEM workload without claiming a converged solve.
pass_criteria: The model, topology, true DOF target and construction procedure are predeclared.
Two deterministic constructions produce identical DOF, partition, ownership and input digests.
The distributed operator and initial preconditioner are built under the Owner-approved RAM, disk and setup budgets.
Bronze is recorded as capacity/preflight evidence only, never as a solve claim.
stop_conditions: budget breach without explicit resource-limited verdict

work_packages.title: 5M Silver
work_packages.objective: Attempt and, if successful, qualify a full reproducible 5M-DOF solve under the frozen MPI contract.
pass_criteria: 5M Bronze passes first.
The complete FEM solve converges twice with the frozen MPI/backend configuration.
Residual, equilibrium, energy, finite outputs, iterations, time and per-rank RSS pass their predeclared criteria.
No acceptance criterion or configuration is retuned after the first result.

work_packages.title: Execution Contract, Recovery and Diagnostics
work_packages.objective: Make large-run failures, retries, recovery and diagnostic states explicit and fail-closed.
pass_criteria: Setup, solve, communication, I/O and post phases have deterministic outcome classes.
Retry/recovery state preserves input, ownership and checkpoint digests where applicable.
Timeout, memory, convergence and backend failures cannot become PASS silently.

work_packages.title: Existing Routes Maturity and Targeted V&V
work_packages.objective: Close only existing route gaps that can change a public maturity decision, without adding physics.
pass_criteria: Selected routes have predeclared, machine-readable targeted evidence.
Qualification remains non-transitive across element, solver, analysis and material routes.
Existing limitations and NOT_QUALIFIED/EXPERIMENTAL states remain visible.
stop_conditions: qualification inferred from an unrelated route
evidence added without a maturity decision boundary

work_packages.title: Mixed, WEDGE15, PYRAMID5 and HEX8 Decisions
work_packages.objective: Make explicit go/defer decisions from evidence rather than introducing new elements or formulations by default.
pass_criteria: Mixed TET/WEDGE/HEX, WEDGE15, PYRAMID5 and HEX8R/SRI/B-bar receive explicit decision records.
Deferred or experimental routes are not exposed as qualified capabilities.
Any implementation proposal is separated from the LU2 qualification claim.
stop_conditions: low-order diagnostic treated as a formulation promotion

work_packages.title: Release Truth, Registry, CI and Final Qualification
work_packages.objective: Reconcile the LU2 evidence, claims, registry, package, CI and final Owner decision.
pass_criteria: All mandatory LU2 records have source/configuration/result provenance.
The public registry and claims match the demonstrated bounded scope.
The final regression/release/Owner review is executed at a declared checkpoint.
The final decision is explicitly RELEASE or NEW_LEVEL_UP; no release is automatic.

conditional_gates.title: Matrix-Free TET4 Capacity Spike
conditional_gates.trigger: Only if 5M exposes a real memory, capacity or performance problem.
pass_criteria: trigger evidence is recorded
scope remains bounded
no universal capacity claim

conditional_gates.title: GPU Foundation
conditional_gates.trigger: Explicit future decision and suitable hardware or CI availability.
conditional_gates.scope: capability detection, backend contract and PETSc CUDA/HIP path only
pass_criteria: backend detection is fail-closed
runtime selection is explicit
real hardware evidence exists before any GPU claim

conditional_gates.title: 10M Scaling and Capacity Exploration
conditional_gates.trigger: Only after LU2-WP05 5M Silver is PASS.
conditional_gates.scope: 10M Bronze/capacity first; full solve is an optional attempt
pass_criteria: 10M Bronze is reported honestly
any solve has full provenance
failure never blocks LU2

3M_GOLD.required_addition: second materially distinct 3M FEM workload with two replays
3M_GOLD.claim_boundary: structured TET4 linear-static / recorded machine and MPI configuration

test_policy.full_regression: LU2-WP09 only or major transversal change

DECISION_GATE_1.basis: Level-Up 1 is acquired and closed at 50 percent; LU2 is installed as the next independent program block.

artifact_classification.CONTROLLED_PROOF: versioned evidence with declared source, environment and digest
artifact_classification.GENERATED_VIEW: reader-facing view derived from controlled records
artifact_classification.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: immutable evidence from LU1 or an earlier source snapshot
artifact_classification.BUILD_ARTIFACT: generated package/build output, not a source or proof record

provenance_policy.text_digest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 LF bytes
